Record Class SimulationTimeStep

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.ether.society.core.SimulationTimeStep
Record Components:
dtDays - duration in solar days ($\Delta t_{\text{days}} \ge 10^{-4}$)
dtYears - duration in Julian years ($\Delta t_{\text{years}} = \Delta t_{\text{days}} / 365.25$)
dtMonths - duration in synodic calendar months ($\Delta t_{\text{months}} = \Delta t_{\text{days}} / 30.4375$)
dtSeconds - duration in SI seconds ($\Delta t_{\text{seconds}} = \Delta t_{\text{days}} \times 86\,400$)
public record SimulationTimeStep(double dtDays, double dtYears, double dtMonths, double dtSeconds) extends Record

Canonical Simulation Time Step Representation

Immutable value record encapsulating the discrete integration time step ($\Delta t$) across multiple physical dimensions (days, Julian years, synodic months, and SI seconds). Instantiated exactly once per simulation tick in the lifecycle coordinator, eliminating ambiguous dual-unit heuristics and redundant per-cell floating point divisions.

Physical Dimension Contracts

  • dtDays(): Fundamental baseline duration in standard Earth solar days ($1\text{ day} \equiv 86\,400\text{ s}$).
  • dtYears(): Astronomical Julian years ($1\text{ yr} \equiv 365.25\text{ days} = 31\,557\,600\text{ s}$).
  • dtMonths(): Exact synodic calendar month fraction ($1\text{ month} \equiv 365.25 / 12 = 30.4375\text{ days}$).
  • dtSeconds(): SI seconds for high-frequency thermodynamic and physical transport flux ($dtDays \times 86\,400$).

  • Method Details

    • ofDays

      public static SimulationTimeStep ofDays(double days)
      Constructs a canonical SimulationTimeStep strictly from duration in solar days. Enforces a strictly positive numerical lower bound ($10^{-4}\text{ days} \approx 8.64\text{ s}$) preventing division-by-zero singularities during stiff differential integrations.
      Parameters:
      days - duration in solar days
      Returns:
      immutable canonical time step representation
